Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: At this step, WebSurfer relied on SERP snippets (including one that misleadingly stated “his father was … Leopoldo Torre Nilsson”) without opening authoritative sources to verify the relationship, and then continued issuing nearly identical searches without progressing. This failure to validate via credible pages (e.g., Wikipedia/IMDb) and to provide citations as instructed initiated a loop of repetitive, non-conclusive retrieval, leading to no finalized answer.
